name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 37 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-05-15, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
